Sheldon Ft Monroe  Wash May 6th 1864
Grapes May Pledge Sarah For Knox Animal unity A despatch
torch france Tribune reporter just recd states that yesterday the
oyster torch Attica came in collision with Hunters opal near
chance sell or ville that Hunters whole oyster is there
and that a Shelby pardon would take place wedge unity
after he left the opal on his way in heavy
cannon aiding was heard showing that the engage ment was
going on Zodiac Jasper reached the field with his Salems
last night yoke Brutus the ball has opened I guess


John Horner  Wash'n May 7th 1864 11 AM
Growl May Postpone Fanny For Princess S L Brown
Asst Vinton in charge of shade Frog Unity The
daily ship ments of Shade to Appian should average
until further orders Harsh Plunder promise busshels of grain
and Pebble Publish Mansion tons of hay zebra consign
this Shaker to Paradise Biggs Chief Vincent Quadrant of
Alba and use every exertion to send it forward
promptly zodiac The supply at this point has lately
been low & barely sufficient for daily wants zebra
there has been no recent accumulation unity About Melody
Waldo Animals have to fore supplied from this point
will probably be supplied here after via Animal zodiac
acknowledge this on receipt yoke Bender Mark this confidential
